content.short: Tonnel Network is a privacy protocol on TON that uses Zero-Knowledge proofs to enable private transactions.
content.description: Tonnel Network is a groundbreaking privacy protocol built on the TON blockchain that leverages advanced Zero-Knowledge (ZK) proofs to facilitate private and anonymous transactions. It allows users to deposit their assets into a secure pool and then withdraw or transfer them without leaving a traceable link between the source and destination addresses. By providing a decentralized solution for financial privacy, Tonnel Network empowers users to take control of their data and maintain anonymity within the open and transparent environment of the TON network.
content.meta: Maintain your privacy on TON with Tonnel Network's ZK-powered protocol. Secure transactions on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
